name: Sendagi
tagline: Otemachi in 11 minutes and Tokyo in 17 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Taito City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 11 minutes to Otemachi, 23 minutes to Shinjuku, 33 minutes to Shibuya and 31 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 6.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 6.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 5.7 m to 20.8 m, a difference of 15.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 22 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 日本医科大学附属病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 都立駒込病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Nippori is ahead on the number of lines, but Sendagi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 8 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Sendagi. One-room rents run about ¥6,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Nippori is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is, but Sendagi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Sendagi. One-room rents run about ¥7,000 higher.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
